_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. `Procedural3dMutation` is a semio-NATIVE vocabulary carried in `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio`, so no oracle is registered and the decision below records what stands in for one.

oracles.rationale:
A second implementation of the `s.procedural.procedural3d` document and all fourteen typed mutations, in Python, at `../../../../../🧪️tests/mutate-procedural-3d-1/🐍️component.py`. Written from `../🧬️schema/📸️snapshot/🔣️component.json` (the two halves), rules 1, 2, 3 and 4 of `.🧬semio/🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️12/SEMANTIC-MUTATIONS-OVERHAUL/📓️derivation-rules.md`, and the fourteen committed `(before, mutation, diff, outcome, after)` quintets — which are the only statement of four things: that this subset tags its mutations EXTERNALLY, the payload being `{"CreateWidget": {…}}` with a PascalCase variant name as its single key; that `delete-widget` does NOT cascade, leaving both the synapse that named the widget and its layout entry standing, which is why the layout map has its own `delete-widget-position` verb; that `create-generation` appends AND selects; and that `delete-generation` falls back to the first remaining generation when the one it removed was selected. It imports nothing from this repository and transliterates none of its Rust. This registration SUPERSEDES the `procedural-3d-mutation-semantics` no-oracle decision, whose argument — that the document being a COMPOSITION of two unrelated halves, so that every kind lands in exactly one of two top-level fields, "is this subset's own specification, not a fact an external node-graph library could confirm or refute" — was refuted in this same wave by `mutate-fem2d-1`, `mutate-fem3d-1` and `mutate-gismap-1`, which took Python second implementations over this same carrier. A THIRD-PARTY library was declined, not merely absent: no node-graph format models a graph whose layout is a SPARSE side table keyed by node id and whose document's second half is an unrelated parameter history, and none of them reads this carrier. ALL FOURTEEN KINDS ARE ADJUDICATED AND NONE IS REFUSED: this document holds no composed child, so nothing here depends on a content-addressing function no specification states. A SIBLING NOTE, because the count of second implementations must not be overstated: this reference and `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌀️procedural/🗿️artifacts/🌀️procedural2d/🧪️tests/mutate-procedural-2d-1/🐍️component.py` are ONE implementation instantiated twice — the two documents are the same shape and the two vocabularies differ only in three kind names and four argument names, which is precisely what both no-oracle decisions called the specification. TWO DIVERGENCES THE PAIR SURFACED by being written side by side: `delete-widget` raises `mutation.cascade` at level `info` in `mutate-procedural-2d-1` and raises NOTHING in `mutate-procedural-3d-1`, for an effect that is byte-for-byte identical in both committed vectors; and `s.procedural.procedural2d` spells one argument `question_id` in snake_case, the only snake_case identifier in either document model, where its sibling spells it `questionId`. ONE CEILING ON WHAT THIS COMPARISON ESTABLISHES: the SUBJECT half does not run this subset's codec — `../../../../../🧪️tests/mutate-procedural-3d-1/🦀️component.rs` links no plugin crate and replays the committed vectors — so today it establishes that an independent implementation of the specification computes the committed after-snapshots, not yet our codec against a second producer. A `procedural3d_mutation_report_json` bridge beside the mutation enum closes it; it is not added here for two reasons, and neither is that the verb is hard: it is PRODUCTION code in a crate this test-side pass deliberately does not touch, and it could not be verified end to end today anyway. `parity` was not measured for any case in this pass: the single-case probe `parity exhaustive --owner 🗒️note --case mutate-note-1` was killed at the runner's OWN 900 s per-case budget while still COMPILING the generated subject host — the runner's message names the cause, shared cargo target-dir lock contention from a concurrent session — and then threw `spawnSync cargo ETIMEDOUT` out of `runProbe` with no summary line at all. `📓️w14-final-audit.md` §5.3 measured the underlying blocker one day earlier (`unresolved import component::component_persistent_local` in `semio-framework-plugin`, which sits in every generated host's dependency graph); this pass did NOT re-verify whether that is still the state, and says so rather than repeating it as fact. This subset's own plugin crate compiles clean at `cargo check --lib`. This case also reads no real-world artifact: all 70 of its fixtures are handcrafted specification vectors. `package` is deliberately empty: the implementation needs no distribution, so this entry contributes nothing to `🔒️dependencies.json`.

UNDER PROTOCOL V2 this registration is classified `cross-semio-implementation` — a required SUPPLEMENTAL oracle that does not discharge `procedural-3d-1-mutate`'s external-oracle requirement for its 14-kind mutation vocabulary; a qualifying third-party reference (`third-party-library` / `third-party-cli` / `standards-reference-tool`) is still owed.
